title: I’ve played RPGs for 30 years, can’t code or draw, and built an early Floor 1 playtest of a dark-fantasy turn-based RPG with AI — looking for brutally honest feedback
author: Nervous_Dark_2409
selftext:
I've been playing video games for about 30 years, and I've always wanted to make a gritty dark-fantasy turn-based RPG where you aim each blow (head, torso, arms, legs) and injuries actually change the fight.

I'm not a coder or an artist, as many of you, I direct every design, combat, UI, and feel decision myself and use AI tools to build the code and pixel art. This is a very early Floor 1 playtest of Gravewick, focused on testing core combat feel, body-part targeting, and controls.

Play free on itch.io: [https://enytime1987.itch.io/gravewick](https://enytime1987.itch.io/gravewick)  
Discord (feedback / bug reports): [https://discord.gg/WmWJYv7EbP](https://discord.gg/WmWJYv7EbP)

What's coming in the near future:

Expanded Floor 1 encounters, enemy variety, and boss polish  
More weapons, gear, and playable classes (starting with the Poacher)  
Full locomotion & animation upgrades and deeper dungeon floors  
UI and progression polish driven directly by playtester feedback

Would love blunt feedback on what feels good, what feels clunky, and what broke on your first run. Also, if you're a pixel artist who likes dark-fantasy RPGs and wants to collaborate, feel free to message me or drop your work in #the-gallery on Discord.

comments.author: connected_user93
comments.body: All of those sound-effects need to get earmarked as placeholders. They are the same painful stock sounds that chatbots generate for thousands of people's projects. The pixel art is alright, but it could really use some manual cleanup.
